title: Software Engineer - Android Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: Software Engineer - Android.

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas Across Levels
lines: 1. Entry-level / New Grad: Kotlin fundamentals, Jetpack Compose / XML layouts, Activity/Fragment lifecycle, and Retrofit network requests.
2. Mid-level: Android Architecture Components (ViewModel, LiveData/StateFlow), Coroutines & Flow, Room DB, WorkManager background processing, and dependency injection (Hilt/Dagger).
3. Senior: Performance profiling (Android Studio Profiler: memory, CPU, jank detection), baseline profiles, multi-module architecture, ProGuard/R8 rules, and NDK/JNI when applicable.
4. Staff-plus: Android core foundation architecture, design system platformization, and developer tooling at scale.

sections.heading: Question Strategy & Guidance
lines: - PREFER BRIEF PILLARS: Focus on Jetpack Compose, Kotlin Coroutines, and Android platform design patterns.
- Assess handling of process death, configuration changes, and background execution limits (Doze mode).
